Class ShipCorrectionState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.GameState
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckers.server.model.state.ShipCorrectionState
All Implemented Interfaces:
GameStateInterface
public non-sealed class ShipCorrectionState extends GameState implements GameStateInterface
Represents the state of the game where players can correct their ship boards by removing components or choosing ship pieces.

    • setGame

      public void setGame(Game game)
      Sets the game associated with this state and initializes the state.

      Shipboards are also examined to compute their validity and to check if they are connected. Moves on to ShipInitializationState if all ships are correct

      Overrides:
      setGame in class GameState
      Parameters:

    • removeComponent

      public void removeComponent(ShipBoard shipBoard, Point point)
      Removes a component from the specified position on the ship board.
